notes: Fiscal year ends Jan 31 (FQ2'27 = quarter ended 2026-07-31). Only 18 quarters exist (IPO April 2024). FQ1'23-FQ4'23 (quarters ended Apr 2022-Jan 2023) come from the IPO prospectus (424B4) quarterly table; FY24 quarters there tie to XBRL; FQ1'24 onward from XBRL. History is distorted by the 2022-23 shift from perpetual licences/maintenance to subscription, which makes FY23-24 YoY low. Material-rights revenue (4.7 in FQ2'27 vs 14.2) depresses reported growth: 38% reported, 43% normalized. Gross margin is non-GAAP 81.0% (GAAP 78.4%). TTM (FQ3'26-FQ2'27): OCF 337.1, capex 50.8 (PP&E + capitalized software), FCF 286.2 on revenue 1,542.2. Net cash = cash 416.2 + short-term investments 1,331.5 - 2030 convertible notes carrying 1,132.9 ($1.15B principal) at 7/31/26; operating leases excluded. NRR = average subscription dollar-based net retention 'over 119%' (10-Q). Concentration (judgment call): the 10-Q table lists channel partners; end-customer concentration is low, so the scorer's C1 test will overstate the risk. ttm_pe uses non-GAAP diluted EPS 0.10+0.04+0.16+0.20=0.50. eps_growth is null because prior-TTM non-GAAP EPS was -0.57 (-0.21-0.18-0.15-0.03). Price $118.58 at the 2026-10-02 close. | Scoring adjustment (2026-10-04): customer_concentration set to null because the disclosed 74% is four distributors/resellers acting as legal customers, not end-user concentration; original disclosure kept in customer_concentration_channel.

fcf_margin_ttm_pct: Rubrik 8-K Ex.99.1 cash flows FY26 (2026-03-12), H1 FY26 and H1 FY27 (2026-08-27); calc
founder_led: Rubrik 8-K Ex.99.1 (Bipul Sinha, CEO, Chairman and Co-Founder)
ttm_pe: Rubrik 8-K Ex.99.1 non-GAAP diluted EPS FQ3'26-FQ2'27; price from stockanalysis.com statistics page, close of 2026-10-02
ev_ntm_sales: stockanalysis.com statistics page, close of 2026-10-02; EV / (market cap / forward P/S)

customer_concentration_channel.note: 10-Q FQ2'27: channel partners A 26%, B 28%, C 10%, D 10% of Q2 revenue (FY26 10-K: A 27%, B 32%). These are distributors/resellers that are the legal customers, not end users
